one_liner: GOOG +6.88% on 1.3x volume after Cloud grew 82% and Q2 revenue beat — VCP detected with pivot at $370.89 and Grade A fundamentals make this the highest-quality setup on today's watchlist.

price_action.intraday_story: GOOG opened at $340.07, close to prior close, then accelerated higher throughout the session to a $358.88 high before closing at $356.65. The close within $2.23 of the intraday high is a sign of strength — buyers were in control all day and there was no late-day selling pressure. Volume at 1.3x average is elevated but not climactic, which is ideal for a sustainable breakout.

news_catalyst.headline: Alphabet Q2 2026: Revenue +24% YoY, Google Cloud +82%, capex raised to $195-205B for year
news_catalyst.summary: Alphabet reported Q2 revenue of $119.8B (+24% YoY), easily beating estimates. The headline was Google Cloud at 82% growth — a meaningful acceleration from 48% in Q4 2025. Net income of $112.1B surged 298% YoY but was inflated by ~$99B in unrealized gains on equity securities (primarily Anthropic and other AI investments). The company raised full-year capex guidance to $195-205B, which initially caused after-hours weakness, but the market today has clearly decided that Cloud reacceleration justifies the spend. Gemini hitting 950M MAU with DAUs tripling supports the AI product thesis.

technical.vcp_stage: VCP detected — pivot breakout level at $370.89
technical.summary:
The VCP (Volatility Contraction Pattern) detection is the standout technical signal today. The system has identified a pattern of tightening price contractions building toward a pivot at $370.89. Today's 6.88% earnings-driven surge brings GOOG to $356.65 — within 4% of that pivot level.

RSI at 56.33 is healthy — not overbought, leaving room for further upside. MACD histogram at +0.28 just turned positive, confirming the momentum shift. The combination of VCP structure, earnings catalyst, and improving momentum is a high-quality setup.

The trade setup: watch for a brief consolidation near $355-360 over the next 2-5 sessions on declining volume (the Wyckoff Test of the new base), followed by a volume breakout above $370.89. The prior high before the selloff should come into focus as the next resistance level.

wyckoff_narrative:
GOOG's recent event log shows a Selling Climax (SC) followed by a high-volume down day before today's strong up move — this matches Wyckoff Accumulation Phase A-B structure, where supply is being absorbed after a climactic selling event.

Today's +6.88% surge on 1.3x volume looks like a Sign of Strength (SOS) — price advancing on above-average volume with a close near the high. The next expected Wyckoff event is a Low Volume Test (LVT) of the breakout level around $340-345, where price should hold on minimal volume before the next SOS push through $370.89.

The VCP pivot at $370.89 is the confirmation level. A weekly close above $370.89 on expanding volume would signal the start of a Mark-Up phase.

valuation.summary: The base DCF of $1,090 appears to use per-TWD or pre-split share count — not directly comparable. Using analyst consensus of $421.79 vs current $356.65, there is 18.3% upside to the mean target. At 24.2x forward PE with 24% revenue growth and 54.8% margins, GOOG is reasonably valued. The forward PE is only slightly above the market, making it one of the better value propositions among mega-cap tech.

key_strengths: Forward PE 24.2x reasonable for growth rate
key_concerns: Capex raised to $195-205B for 2026 — massive AI spend
Net income inflated by ~$99B in unrealized equity gains
fundamentals.summary: Grade A with the highest fundamentals score among today's active movers. Cloud reacceleration to 82% growth is the defining metric — it validates the AI infrastructure investment thesis and puts Google Cloud on a trajectory to meaningfully challenge AWS. The capex increase is a concern but manageable given the $73B in annual free cash flow pre-AI-spend.

risks: Capex at $195-205B raises concerns about FCF compression in H2 2026
VCP pivot at $370.89 is the confirmation — a failure to break would reset the setup
AI overview monetization remains unproven; if click-through revenue erodes, search growth decelerates
